game.title: Azeroth Survivors
picker.no_gear: No gear worn yet. Bosses drop it for your class, for good.
picker.armory_sub: Race, look, gear and drop tables
picker.controls_hint: WASD or both mouse buttons to run · 1 2 3 picks a card · R rerolls · Enter to play
opt.deselectOnClick.tip: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield.  Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.
opt.assistAttack.tip: Automatically attack a target when you acquire it by using "/assist".
opt.autoSelfCast.tip: When this is enabled, friendly target spells that you cast while you have a non friendly target or no target will automatically be self cast. This function has a hotkey that can be assigned.
opt.mouseInvertPitch.tip: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.
opt.mousespeed.tip: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.
opt.autointeract.tip: Use mouse clicks to move your character to destinations.
opt.cameraSmoothStyle.tip: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
opt.cameraTerrainTilt.tip: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.
opt.cameraBobbing.tip: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.
opt.cameraYawSmoothSpeed.tip: Adjust the camera movement speed in Always and Smart following styles.
opt.cameraWaterCollision.tip: Set the camera to be above water when your character is above water, and below water when your character is below water.
opt.cameraPivot.tip: Lets you free look when the camera is on the ground.
opt.cameraYawMoveSpeed.tip: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.
opt.cameraDistanceMaxFactor.tip: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.
opt.padInvertX.tip: Flips the right stick's left and right: pushing it right turns the view left.
opt.padInvertY.tip: Flips the right stick's up and down on the view.
opt.padLookSpeed.tip: How fast the right stick turns and tilts the view.
opt.padZoomSpeed.tip: How fast the bumpers and triggers zoom the view in and out.
opt.padDeadZone.tip: How far a stick tilts before it counts. Raise it if the hero or the view drifts on its own.
opt.UberTooltips.tip: Enable detailed tooltips in the lower right hand corner of the screen.
opt.statusBarText.tip: Always display the text on XP, health, mana, rage, energy, or happiness status bars.
opt.SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET.tip: Toggles the display of the target of your target.
opt.SHOW_TARGET_OF_TARGET_STATE.tip: Sets Target of Target to always display.
opt.QUEST_FADING_DISABLE.tip: Check this to make quest text appear instantly.
opt.SHOW_BUFF_DURATIONS.tip: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.
opt.AUTO_QUEST_WATCH.tip: Quests are automatically watched for 5 minutes when you achieve a quest objective.
opt.showGameTips.tip: Uncheck this to hide the tip of the day in the load screens.
opt.SHOW_NEWBIE_TIPS.tip: Show detailed information about various user interface elements.  Advanced players may want to turn this off.
opt.meterOnTop.tip: Keeps the damage meter over the level-up and jewelry cards, so you can check your damage while you pick.
opt.hudScale.tip: Sizes the run's own HUD: the clock and the boss's bar, kills and gold, your spells and jewelry, and the damage meter.
opt.hudClock.tip: The run's clock and the time to the next boss, at the top of the screen.
opt.hudBosses.tip: The health bars of the bosses and awake guardians you are fighting.
opt.hudTally.tip: The box with your kills and gold beside the minimap.
opt.hudBuild.tip: Your spells and jewelry with their cooldowns.
opt.hudBanners.tip: The messages in the middle of the screen, such as a boss arriving.
opt.hudLoot.tip: The notice of a piece of gear a boss dropped.
opt.hudMeter.tip: The damage meter's button on the minimap and its window.
opt.cacheOnClick.tip: Caches are bought only when you right-click them, not when you walk over them. Helps keep a run free of caches for Thrifty.
opt.storeLevels.tip: Level-ups no longer stop the fight. They are stored, and a Level Up! button over your action bars opens them when you are ready.
opt.noSpellEffects.tip: Draws no spell effects: no explosions, missiles, glows or beams, only your hero's casting animation. Spells still sound. For a slow computer.
opt.menuScene.tip: What the main menu stands over: the picked zone, flown over slowly, or a plain black screen for a slower computer or phone.
opt.discordPresence.tip: Shows what you are playing on your Discord profile: your hero's name, race and class, the zone, your level, kills and boss fights, your top spell and the run's time. Needs the Discord app running.
opt.ALWAYS_SHOW_MULTIBARS.tip: Check this option to always display extra actionbars.
opt.LOCK_ACTIONBAR.tip: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.
opt.SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT.tip: Checking this will enable additional combat messages to appear in the playfield.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_FLOAT_MODE.tip: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_LOW_HEALTH_MANA.tip: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS.tip: Shows a message when the player gains an aura.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURA_FADE.tip: Shows a message when an aura fades from the player.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_STATE.tip: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_DODGE_PARRY_MISS.ti: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_RESISTANCES.tip: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REPUTATION.tip: Shows a message when the player gains or loses reputation with a faction.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REACTIVES.tip: Shows when reactive class specific abilities and spells become available (e.g. Overpower for warriors).
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_FRIENDLY_NAMES.tip: Shows the name of a friendly caster when they cast a heal spell on you.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBO_POINTS.tip: Shows the number of combo points you have each time you acquire a new one.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_MANA.tip: Shows all instant gains of mana, rage, and energy.
opt.COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_HONOR_GAINED.tip: Shows the honor you gain from killing other players.
opt.CombatDamage.tip: Display damage numbers over hostile creatures when damaged.
opt.CombatLogPeriodicSpells.tip: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.
opt.PetMeleeDamage.tip: Show damage caused by your pet.
opt.combatLogFile.tip: Writes every combat log line to WoWCombatLog.txt in the Logs folder of benilla-config, beside the game, as the /combatlog command does. The file keeps growing while this is on.
opt.guildMemberNotify.tip: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.
opt.REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY.tip: Check to show chat windows immediately upon mouseover.
opt.ChatBubbles.tip: Shows /say and /yell text in speech bubbles above characters' heads.
opt.showLootSpam.tip: Uncheck this to hide individual loot roll messages and only show the winner.
opt.ChatBubblesParty.tip: Shows party chat text in speech bubbles above party members' heads.
opt.spamFilter.tip: Disables spam filtering on chat text.
opt.UnitNamePlayer.tip: Always display player names in the game world.
opt.UnitNamePlayerGuild.tip: Always display player guild names in the game world.
opt.UnitNameNPC.tip: Always display NPC names in the game world.
opt.uiScale.tip: Changes the size of the game’s user interface.
opt.farclip.tip: Changes how far you can see terrain. Decrease to improve performance.
opt.WorldDetail.tip: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.
opt.spellEffectLevel.tip: Controls the detail level of spell effects.  Decrease to improve performance.
opt.gamma.tip: Lightens or darkens the whole picture: nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.
opt.weatherDensity.tip: Controls the intensity of weather effects.  Decrease to improve performance.
opt.gxWindow.tip: Windowed (Fullscreen) fills the screen with a borderless window; Windowed runs in an ordinary one.
opt.gxVSync.tip: Synchronizes your framerate to some fraction of your monitor's refresh rate. Enable this if you see excessive screen tearing in game.
opt.renderScale.tip: Draws the 3D world at a fraction of the window's resolution, or larger than it. Below 100% trades sharpness for frame rate; above 100% smooths edges at the cost of frame rate.
opt.MasterSoundEffects.tip: Enables or disables all game sound.
opt.SoundZoneMusicNoDelay.tip: Starts the next music track as soon as one ends, instead of after a stretch of silence.
opt.EnableErrorSpeech.tip: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").
opt.Sound_EnableSoundWhenGameIsInBG.tip: Keeps the game's sound playing while you are working in another window.
opt.UnitNamePlayerPVPTitle.tip: Shows players' PvP rank titles with their names.
opt.gxMultisample.tip: Smooths the jagged edges of the 3D world at some cost in frame rate; your graphics card may offer less than asked. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
opt.anisotropic.tip: Keeps the ground and walls sharp when seen at a slant. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
opt.trilinear.tip: Smooths the steps between a texture's levels of detail. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
opt.ffxGlow.tip: A soft glow around the bright parts of the picture. Turn it off for a sharper picture or a slower computer.
opt.ffxDeath.tip: Turns the world grey while your hero is dead.
opt.EmoteSounds.tip: Plays the voices of emotes such as /cheer and /laugh.
opt.SoundListenerAtCharacter.tip: Hears the world from where your hero stands rather than from the camera.
opt.checkAddonVersion.tip: Loads addons made for another version of the game too. They may not work.
options.imported: Imported {name}: your progress is now the one it holds.
options.hint.keybindings: Click a key, then press the key, mouse button or wheel to bind to it. Right-click a key to unbind it.
options.hint.addons: AddOns are turned on or off for every hero and load at your next run.
options.hint.saves: Importing a save replaces all of your progress with the one in the file.
options.hint.gamepad: Left stick moves, right stick turns the view, A jumps, bumpers and triggers zoom, Y opens stored level-ups. Changes apply at once.
options.hint: Changes are saved at once and apply to your next run.
options.install_note: Pick one or more addon .zip files. AddOns made for WoW 1.12 work.
options.addons_folder_note: Put each addon's folder (made for WoW 1.12) in {path}
options.saves_about: Your progress (heroes, the zones each class has opened, gear, talents and the codex) as a file: to keep a copy, or to carry it to another computer or browser.
options.replace_confirm: Replace all of your progress with {name}?
options.exports_go_to: Exports go to {path}. Put a save file there to import it.
options.backups_about: Every hour you play, the game keeps a backup of your progress (the last 5). Import one to go back to it.
options.no_export_folder: There is no folder to export to.
options.export_failed: The save could not be written: {error}
options.no_bindings: The key bindings could not be read from the game's data.
save.not_a_save: That is not an Azeroth Survivors save file.
save.damaged: That save file is damaged or was edited, and cannot be read.

class.warrior.name: Warrior
class.warrior.blurb: Unstoppable in the thick of it. Huge health, cleaving swings, and every kill feeds the fury.
class.paladin.name: Paladin
class.paladin.blurb: Holy ground and righteous hammers. Heals himself, shrugs off death once in a while.
class.hunter.name: Hunter
class.hunter.blurb: Death from range. Arrows, traps and volleys, as long as you keep your distance.
class.rogue.name: Rogue
class.rogue.blurb: Fast, fragile and lethal. The quickest hero, with crits that delete elites.
class.priest.name: Priest
class.priest.blurb: Light and Shadow. Shields and heals keep you alive while pain spreads through the horde.
class.shaman.name: Shaman
class.shaman.blurb: Storms that jump from foe to foe, and totems that fight beside you.
class.mage.name: Mage
class.mage.blurb: The glass cannon. The biggest area damage in Azeroth, and nothing to hide behind.
class.warlock.name: Warlock
class.warlock.blurb: Curses and fire. Damage over time stacks up on everything that chases you.
class.druid.name: Druid
class.druid.blurb: Moon, storm and growth. Roots, hurricanes and the steadiest self-healing.

zone.elwynn.name: Elwynn Forest
zone.elwynn.subtitle: The Defias Uprising
zone.elwynn.blurb: Kobolds pour out of Jasperlode Mine, gnolls cross the river and the Defias Brotherhood marches on the farms. Their leader waits for you at the end.
boss.690.name: Hogger
boss.691.name: Mother Fang
boss.691.yell: Mother Fang skitters out of the mine!
boss.692.name: Rhahk'Zor
boss.692.yell: VanCleef pay big for your heads!
boss.693.name: Mr. Smite
boss.693.yell: We're under attack! Avast, ye swabs! Repel the invaders!
boss.694.name: Edwin VanCleef
zone.duskwood.name: Duskwood
zone.duskwood.subtitle: Night of the Nightbane
zone.duskwood.blurb: The graves of Raven Hill stand open. Worgen hunt between the trees, and Morbent Fel calls the dead of Duskwood to war.
boss.790.name: Naraxis
boss.791.name: Mor'Ladim
boss.791.yell: You will join my army in death!
boss.792.name: Stitches
boss.793.name: Lupos
boss.793.yell: Lupos howls, and the Nightbane answer!
boss.794.name: Morbent Fel
boss.794.yell: The dead of Raven Hill rise at my command!
zone.wsg.name: Warsong Gulch
zone.wsg.subtitle: The Burning Legion
zone.wsg.blurb: A demon gate tears open over the gulch. Imps, felhounds and satyrs pour through, and Lord Kazzak follows.
boss.190.name: Doomguard Commander
boss.190.yell: Your world is ours to burn!
boss.191.name: Mannoroth's Herald
boss.192.name: Varimathras
boss.192.yell: The dreadlords remember Warsong. Do you?
boss.194.name: Lord Hel'nurath
boss.194.yell: Who dares summon Hel'nurath? Your soul is forfeit!
boss.193.name: Lord Kazzak
zone.ab.name: Arathi Basin
zone.ab.subtitle: The Highlands Rise
zone.ab.blurb: With the Basin's banners down, the Highlands come for it: Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls out of the hills, and the Syndicate behind them, sent by the last lord of Alterac to take it for his own.
zone.feralas.name: Feralas
zone.feralas.subtitle: The Gates of Dire Maul
zone.feralas.blurb: The Gordunni ogres break out of Dire Maul with the Woodpaw gnolls and the wild things of Feralas behind them. King Gordok himself comes to claim the forest.
boss.890.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
boss.890.yell: Your blood will feed the forest's corruption!
boss.891.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
boss.892.name: Tendris Warpwood
boss.893.name: Immol'thar
boss.893.yell: Immol'thar breaks free of its prison!
boss.894.name: King Gordok
zone.arena.name: Gurubashi Arena
zone.arena.subtitle: The Blood God Wakes
zone.arena.blurb: The Hakkari turn the Arena into an altar. Trolls, raptors and the Blood God's serpents fill the ring, and Hakkar the Soulflayer walks the world again.
boss.990.name: High Priestess Jeklik
boss.990.yell: Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!
boss.991.name: High Priest Venoxis
boss.991.yell: Let the coils of hate unfurl!
boss.992.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
boss.992.yell: I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!
boss.993.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
boss.993.yell: Welcome to da great show, friends. Step right up to die!
boss.994.name: Hakkar the Soulflayer
boss.994.yell: PRIDE HERALDS THE END OF YOUR WORLD. COME, MORTALS! FACE THE WRATH OF THE SOULFLAYER!
zone.av.name: Alterac Valley
zone.av.subtitle: The Frozen Wilds
zone.av.blurb: The valley wakes. Troggs swarm from the mines, the wolves are starving, and the Ice Lord stirs beneath the snow.
boss.390.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
boss.391.name: Ivus the Forest Lord
boss.391.yell: Who disturbs the slumber of the forest?
boss.392.name: Lokholar the Ice Lord
boss.392.yell: I am the Ice Lord. Your blood will freeze in your veins!
boss.394.name: Glacius the Frozen Titan
boss.394.yell: The mountain remembers. The mountain will bury you!
boss.393.name: Azuregos
boss.393.yell: This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate!
zone.brm.name: Blackrock Mountain
zone.brm.subtitle: The Lord of Blackrock
zone.brm.blurb: The Dark Iron and the Blackrock clan march out of the mountain together, fire elementals and dragonkin at their side. Above them circles the Lord of Blackrock.
boss.1090.name: General Angerforge
boss.1090.yell: Dark Iron! To arms! Crush the intruders!
boss.1091.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
boss.1091.yell: Blackrock will never fall! For the true Horde!
boss.1092.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
boss.1093.name: Majordomo Executus
boss.1093.yell: Reckless mortals! None may challenge the sons of the living flame!
boss.1094.name: Nefarian
boss.1094.yell: Well done, my minions. The mortals' courage begins to wane! Now let's see how they contend with the true Lord of Blackrock Spire!
zone.aq.name: Gates of Ahn'Qiraj
zone.aq.subtitle: The Old God Stirs
zone.aq.blurb: The Scarab Wall has fallen. The silithid swarm and the Qiraji legions spill across the sands, and behind them C'Thun opens its eye.
boss.1190.name: Kurinnaxx
boss.1190.yell: The sands erupt as Kurinnaxx surfaces!
boss.1191.name: General Rajaxx
boss.1191.yell: Impudent fool! I will kill you myself!
boss.1192.name: Princess Huhuran
boss.1192.yell: Princess Huhuran goes into a frenzy!
boss.1193.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
boss.1193.yell: Sands of the desert, rise and block out the sun!
boss.1194.name: C'Thun
weapon.hunter.0.4: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers
weapon.rogue.0.4: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
lore.plain.0: Plain work, but it helps a blow land where it hurts.
lore.plain.1: Sturdy, if nothing much to look at.
lore.plain.2: Well fitted; it keeps its wearer fresh and ready.
lore.plain.3: Light and well cut; it never slows you down.
lore.plain.4: Simple, comfortable, and easy to rest in.
lore.plain.5: Thick and warm, made for long days on the road.
lore.plain.6: Cut for moving quickly and hitting hard.
lore.plain.7: Its maker had a good eye, and so will its wearer.
lore.warrior.0: Notched by a hundred killing blows.
lore.warrior.1: Hammered thick enough to turn an axe.
lore.warrior.2: Worn by those who never tire of the charge.
lore.warrior.3: Light enough to reach the foe first, and find the gap in its armor.
lore.warrior.4: A veteran's gear: the wounds close, and the next blow is ready.
lore.warrior.5: Made for those who bleed and keep standing.
lore.warrior.6: Made for running down what flees.
